title: Ethical Risk Assessment of the Data Harnessing Process of LLM supported on Consensus of Well-known Multi-Ethical Frameworks
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. It proposes a general 'Ethical Risk Scoring (ERS)' framework to assess the data harnessing process of LLMs based on broad ethical principles like harm mitigation, transparency, and data rights.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion as it is not a subject of the study.
